description: This Java class `Jwt` represents a JWT token message used within the Eclipse Ditto streaming gateway service, encapsulating the token string and connection correlation ID.

classes.name: Jwt
classes.description: Immutable class representing a JWT token with associated connection correlation ID, used for stream control messages.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new Jwt instance with provided token string and connection ID.

methods.name: getConnectionCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns the correlation ID associated with the connection that received this token.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on JWT string and connection correlation ID.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on connection correlation ID and JWT string.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the JWT token.
